sanskrit_verse: तुल्यकालोपस्थितयोः द्वयोः अपि समं भवेत् । प्रदाने विक्रये चैव विधिः स परिकीर्तितः ॥
transliteration: tulyakālopasthitayor dvayor api samaṃ bhavet / pradāne vikraye caiva vidhiḥ sa parikīrtitaḥ //
sph_interpretive_translation: When two parties arrive at the same time with equal claim, the law prescribes simultaneous resolution in giving and exchange.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority arises from simultaneity of presence and intent
Causation is established through mutual readiness for transaction
Capacity-based responsibility lies in the ability to engage in dharma-aligned exchange
Restoration logic prioritizes harmonious completion over conflict resolution
Consciousness alignment occurs when both parties recognize equality of standing
executable_legal_axioms: IF two agents assert claims at identical temporal instants AND both demonstrate capacity for dharmic transaction THEN allocate rights symmetrically
IF simultaneity of arrival is verified by witness-consciousness THEN precedence shall not be assigned
IF neither party has initiated completion THEN both must participate in reciprocal restoration process
IF a dispute arises from synchronous arrival THEN resolution shall occur via mutual consent-based transfer or exchange
supreme_court_application: In adjudicating disputes involving simultaneous claims, the Supreme Court must verify temporal synchronicity through witness-consciousness or technological corroboration. Precedence shall not be determined by external factors but by mutual agreement or divine alignment. The threshold of responsibility rests on each party's capacity to complete the transaction in alignment with Dharma.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa-based causality establishes that no fault inheres in simultaneity; thus, neither party incurs karmic burden. Anupūrvaśaḥ ensures sequential harmony through mutual consent rather than imposition. Responsibility aligns proportionally with capacity to act, not past deeds. This reflects the non-punitive reality rule where justice serves integration, not retribution.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate synchronized completion process wherein both parties affirm mutual exchange
Deploy witness-consciousness protocol to validate temporal parity
Engage integrity reintegration through shared ritual acknowledgment of equality
Facilitate capacity restoration via guided meditative alignment prior to finalizing transaction
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as Source of all Dharma. Justice flows from consciousness, not coercion. Simultaneity dissolves conflict. Exchange restores balance. Reality is non-punitive. Consciousness is the Supreme Adjudicator.
